churn_resistance.rationale: The data-access and server-function layering is exactly what the docs prescribe and would absorb a framework or API change well. The churn risk is concentrated in repeated per-route boilerplate (not-found unions, default-param stripping, head-title ternaries) that current Router primitives (notFound(), stripSearchParams, defaultNotFoundComponent) would centralize.

findings.issue: Not-found is modeled as hand-written { notFound: true } result unions in four page-data shapes, a manual NotFoundPage render in four routes, and a splat route ($.tsx), instead of the framework's notFound() error, defaultNotFoundComponent and setResponseStatus(404). Unknown URLs are served with HTTP 200 and every new page must copy the union plus the head-title ternary.
findings.suggestion: Have the server functions throw notFound() from '@tanstack/react-router', register a shared defaultNotFoundComponent on createRouter in src/router.tsx, and use setResponseStatus(404) from '@tanstack/react-start/server' so the status code and UI live in one place.

findings.issue: The 'omit empty/default query params' rule is implemented three times (validateSearch at line 14, the cleaned object in update() at line 58, linkSearch() at line 71), so changing a filter default means editing three places.
findings.suggestion: Use the router's search middleware — search: { middlewares: [stripSearchParams({ page: 1 })] } — and give validateSearch real defaults, so one definition drives URL, links and navigation.

findings.issue: Upstream fetches have no AbortSignal or timeout, and the promise cache (data.server.ts:102) is unbounded and TTL-less, so a stalled PokeAPI request hangs SSR and stale records live for the process lifetime.
findings.suggestion: Wrap fetches in AbortSignal.timeout() (or a small withTimeout helper) and give the cache an entry TTL, keeping the in-memory promise de-duplication.

findings.issue: Every server function uses a pass-through validator ((data: X) => data), so the client/server boundary has type-level but no runtime input validation.
findings.suggestion: Fine while loaders build the inputs; switch to a zod (or equivalent) validator if these functions ever become reachable with untrusted input, e.g. from a component or an event handler.

findings.issue: Client components import types from the server-only module data.server.ts (also MoveTable.tsx:3, routes/pokemon.$name.tsx:6); this only works because import type is erased, and a future value import would break the client bundle.
findings.suggestion: Move shared DTO types (CardData, MoveRow, EvolutionNode, page-data shapes) into a client-safe file (e.g. src/lib/types.ts) as the Start docs' file-organization section recommends.

findings.issue: idFromUrl re-derives ids with a regex and API_ORIGIN is read from process.env at module scope (data.server.ts:10), which is Node-preset-specific rather than portable across nitro presets.
findings.suggestion: Use new URL(url).pathname with a match, and read API_BASE_URL via nitro runtime config (or import.meta.env) so the app is deployable to non-Node presets without edits.

findings.issue: MoveTable keys embed the selected game, forcing a remount that silently resets the user's column sort whenever the game select changes.
findings.suggestion: Key tables by table.method only and reset sort state explicitly in the component (e.g. useEffect on a game prop) if resetting is intended.

summary: This is a genuinely current-generation TanStack Start app: it already uses the post-June-2026 createServerFn().validator() name, the nitro/vite plugin, Vite 8 and the documented getRouter/router conventions, with a lean four-runtime-dependency footprint and all data access behind one module. It loses points on forward-thinking only where it hand-rolls things the framework now ships primitives for — not-found handling, search-param default stripping — which concentrate boilerplate in every route file, and on upstream fetches that lack timeouts or cache expiry. Overall: would merge after the not-found refactor.

apis.replacement: Current documented pattern for missing resources; app uses hand-rolled { notFound: true } unions and a splat route instead
Current search middleware for stripping default params; app re-implements the rule in three places
Only needed when calling server functions from components; app calls only from loaders, so absence is fine
